{{Quote|I am Skull Shatter. I speak with fire. Blood Scream bellows thunderous power. You&hellip; you are a pestilence.|Skull Shatter|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Blood Scream''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Esh-kha]] warrior who was imprisoned with the rest of his [[Species/Legends|species]] by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] in [[the Tomb]] on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. During the [[invasion of Belsavis]] in the [[Galactic War]], the Esh-kha were released, and Blood Scream was among the warriors who fought to eradicate the "pestilence" of non-Esh-kha. Although considered a "power couple," Blood Scream and another warrior, [[Skull Shatter]], were [[Death/Legends|slain]] by Imperials in battle among the vaults of the Tomb.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Blood Scream appears on Belsavis in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', where he and Skull Shatter must be defeated in the Imperial mission "Erasing the Esh-kha."<ref name="TOR" />
